# The runtime of C++ applications generated by Clarity: records and
# storage in SQLite, queries, migrations, pictures and files, the binding
# to the screen, the service of the screen's commands, the web server and
# the desktop program on Clarity.UI.
# Written by hand once and copied into every generated project. This file
# builds it on its own, with its tests:
#
#   cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build
#
# The desktop's tests drive Clarity.UI's library, found where CLARITY_UI
# says (a folder with include/clarity_ui.h and lib/).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(clarity_runtime LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

include(clarity.cmake)

enable_testing()
file(GLOB CLARITY_TESTS CONFIGURE_DEPENDS tests/*.cpp)
add_executable(clarity_tests ${CLARITY_TESTS})
# The HTTP test runs its own small server on a thread.
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
target_link_libraries(clarity_tests PRIVATE clarity clarity_desktop clarity_engine clarity_http clarity_secrets Threads::Threads)
if(WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(clarity_tests PRIVATE ws2_32)
endif()
target_compile_definitions(clarity_tests PRIVATE CLARITY_CONFORMANCE="${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../conformance")
clarity_ui_beside(clarity_tests)
# The data formats of code run on Clarity.Formats (formats_test.cpp).
clarity_use_formats(clarity_tests)
add_test(NAME clarity_tests COMMAND clarity_tests)
# Fetching Clarity.UI's library from its release (clarity_ui.cmake), from a release made in the test.
add_test(NAME clarity_ui_fetch COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DWORK=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/clarity_ui_fetch -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/clarity_ui_fetch.cmake)
